interventions.title: Spec-driven agentic development
interventions.x: Specifications have always framed what software must do.

interventions.z: MAGE binds intent into drift-checked models — the spec is not a document but an enforced, executable model the environment holds implementation to.

interventions.title: Engineer role / SE-education
interventions.x: Software engineering has always been more than typing code.

interventions.z: MAGE describes where the seat moves — human effort concentrates on intent, architecture, model authorship, validation, and judgment — not that coding is obsolete.
